title: University Department & Faculty
scenario: A University strictly owns its Departments (if a university closes, its departments cease to exist). A Department groups Professors, though Professors can exist independently. Professors are associated with the Courses they teach.
goal: Model strict ownership, shared membership, and teaching relationships across University, Department, Professor, and Course.
learningObjective: Distinguish Composition (strong ownership), Aggregation (weak/shared ownership), and Association.
hints: Strong lifecycle ownership uses Composition (University -> Department).
Independent parts grouped into a whole use Aggregation (Department -> Professor).
Use Association between Professor and Course.
solutionExplanation: University composes Department, Department aggregates Professor, and Professor associates with Course.

solutions.description: Composition, Aggregation, and Association in academic domain
